<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915244_theRebbe_950" batchId="chunked-post-1783581047769-part-003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section questions how the maamar can speak of "peace" in both the top-down and bottom-up modes of refinement, when the bottom-up mode is usually associated with struggle.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And seemingly it must be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that the intent</t>
    <t s="2">(in the maamar)</t>
    <t s="3">in "from above to below" and "from below to above" is</t>
    <t s="4">(also)</t>
    <t s="5">for the two manners in the matter of the refinements</t>
    <t s="6">(the matter of "and I will return,"</t>
    <t s="7">the return of the sparks to their source),</t>
    <t s="8">refinement in the manner of from above to below and refinement in the manner of from below to above.</t>
    <t s="9">And it must be understood,</t>
    <t s="10">behold it is explained in many places</t>
    <t s="11">[and also in the aforementioned maamar</t>
    <t s="12">(beginning with the words "Padeh b'Shalom")</t>
    <t s="13">that the Master of the Redemption,</t>
    <t s="14">brought above in sections alef-beit],</t>
    <t s="15">that the matter of peace is in the refinement in the manner of from above to below</t>
    <t s="16">(refinement through the revelation of light),</t>
    <t s="17">but not so the refinement in the manner of from below to above</t>
    <t s="18">(refinement in the manner of enclothing)</t>
    <t s="19">is in a manner of war,</t>
    <t s="20">and from this that it says that the explanation of "b'Shalom" is two kinds of peace,</t>
    <t s="21">peace from above to below and peace from below to above,</t>
    <t s="22">it implies that also the refinement from below to above is in a manner of peace.</t>
    <t s="23">And to add,</t>
    <t s="24">from this that it is said "and I will return in peace" two kinds of peace</t>
    <t s="25">(that both must be present),</t>
    <t s="26">it implies,</t>
    <t s="27">that in each one of them there is an advantage.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that in the top-down refinement the opposing entity is nullified, whereas in the bottom-up refinement the lower entity is refined through its own will and understanding, so its essential opposition remains latent.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">e)</t>
    <t s="1">And the matter is,</t>
    <t s="2">that in peace</t>
    <t s="3">(which is brought about through refinement)</t>
    <t s="4">there are two manners.</t>
    <t s="5">That the opposing entity is nullified – and this manner is</t>
    <t s="6">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="7">in the refinement in the manner of from above to below.</t>
    <t s="8">For in the refinement in the manner of from below to above,</t>
    <t s="9">where the refiner enclothes himself in that which is being refined and engages with it so that it will desire to be refined,</t>
    <t s="10">this is not that the lower entity</t>
    <t s="11">(that which is being refined)</t>
    <t s="12">is nullified, but rather it is refined from the aspect of its own will.</t>
    <t s="13">And since even after it has been refined it is an existence of a lower entity</t>
    <t s="14">(for lower and higher are opposites),</t>
    <t s="15">therefore,</t>
    <t s="16">even after it has been refined,</t>
    <t s="17">it is possible that it will oppose the higher entity.</t>
    <t s="18">And in the service of man this is,</t>
    <t s="19">that the refinement of the Nefesh HaBahamis through the Nefesh HaElokis enclothing itself in the Nefesh HaBahamis,</t>
    <t s="20">is,</t>
    <t s="21">that the contemplation of the Nefesh HaElokis is in a manner that also the Nefesh HaBahamis will understand and grasp the Divine matter</t>
    <t s="22">(in which it contemplates)</t>
    <t s="23">so that through this it will come to love HaShem.</t>
    <t s="24">For this that the Nefesh HaBahamis loves HaShem</t>
    <t s="25">(although by its nature it is drawn to physical matters)</t>
    <t s="26">is</t>
    <t s="27">(not through its existence being nullified,</t>
    <t s="28">but rather on the contrary)</t>
    <t s="29">through the intellect of the Nefesh HaBahamis coming to an understanding that one must love HaShem.</t>
    <t s="30">And since this that the Nefesh HaBahamis loves HaShem</t>
    <t s="31">(including also the understanding and comprehension that one must love HaShem)</t>
    <t s="32">is from the aspect of the intellect of the Nefesh HaElokis</t>
    <t s="33">(which has enclothed itself in the intellect of the Nefesh HaBahamis),</t>
    <t s="34">but the Nefesh HaBahamis from its own aspect is drawn to physical matters</t>
    <t s="35">[and as is explained in many places</t>
    <t s="36">that the refinement of the Nefesh HaBahamis through contemplation is only in the manner of itkafya (suppression)],</t>
    <t s="37">behold even now</t>
    <t s="38">(that also the Nefesh HaBahamis has love of HaShem)</t>
    <t s="39">its opposition to the Nefesh HaElokis remains in concealment</t>
    <t s="40">(except that its opposition does not come into actuality).</t>
    <t s="41">And in order that there be a nullification of the opposing entity, it is through the refinement in the manner of from above to below.</t>
    <t s="42">For through</t>
    <t s="43">there being revealed in the lower entity a revelation of light that is not commensurate with it,</t>
    <t s="44">it is nullified from its existence.</t>
    <t s="45">And in the service of man this is,</t>
    <t s="46">that through there being felt in the Nefesh HaBahamis the love of the Nefesh HaElokis that is beyond intellect and comprehension,</t>
    <t s="47">for this love is</t>
    <t s="48">(generally)</t>
    <t s="49">a great love that is beyond the limitation of the vessel of the heart,</t>
    <t s="50">through this the existence of the Nefesh HaBahamis is nullified,</t>
    <t s="51">and through this it is transformed to good,</t>
    <t s="52">it'hapcha (transformation)</t>
    <t s="53">(which is superior to itkafya).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that in the bottom-up refinement the former opponent becomes a lover, a true change in its own existence, whereas in the top-down refinement the lower entity is nullified but not essentially changed.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And there is another manner in peace</t>
    <t s="1">(which is brought about through refinement),</t>
    <t s="2">that that which was initially an opponent becomes a lover</t>
    <t s="3">(and in the language of the verse</t>
    <t s="4">"even his enemies will make peace with him")</t>
    <t s="5">– and this manner is</t>
    <t s="6">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="7">in the refinement in the manner of from below to above.</t>
    <t s="8">For in the refinement in the manner of from above to below,</t>
    <t s="9">this that the lower entity does not oppose is because it is nullified from its existence through the revelation of light,</t>
    <t s="10">but it is not that a change has been made in the existence of the lower entity itself.</t>
    <t s="11">For although through the revelation of the great love that is beyond intellect and comprehension the Nefesh HaBahamis is transformed to good</t>
    <t s="12">(it'hapcha),</t>
    <t s="13">behold its transformation is</t>
    <t s="14">(not from the aspect of the Nefesh HaBahamis's own essence,</t>
    <t s="15">but rather)</t>
    <t s="16">because through the great love of the Nefesh HaElokis the Nefesh HaBahamis is nullified from its existence.</t>
    <t s="17">And the true essence of the matter of "even his enemies will make peace with him" is in the refinement in the manner of from below to above,</t>
    <t s="18">for this that the Nefesh HaBahamis has love of HaShem is from the aspect of the intellect of the Nefesh HaBahamis.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
